job_title: Graduate Software Engineer, Open Source and Linux, Canonical Ubuntu
summary: Develop open-source software across Linux, cloud, containers, tooling and commercial systems; collaborate through reviews and support users.
requirements: 2026 or 2027 graduates; exceptional academic results; STEM undergraduate degree with programming; proficiency in Python, Rust, C/C++, Go, JavaScript or Java; Linux experience, personal projects and professional English. Open-source contributions are preferred.
conditions: Globally remote with regional team/time-zone alignment. Full time, five days per week. International travel twice a year for events lasting up to two weeks is required.
